items.question: Has the trial balance been agreed to the accounting records, and does it balance?
Has the opening trial balance been agreed to the closing balances of last year?
Has the population of journal entries for the year been obtained, and has its completeness been checked to the trial balance?
Have journals been selected for testing using risk criteria (round amounts, period-end, unusual accounts, unusual users, weekends and holidays)?
Have the selected journals been agreed to supporting documents and the business reason understood?
Have post-closing and year-end adjusting entries been reviewed and approved by someone other than the preparer?
Have all audit adjustments been listed, agreed with management and posted, or the unadjusted ones recorded with a reason?
Have the accounts been mapped to the financial statement lines, and any unmapped or oddly signed accounts explained?
